reading: US President Donald Trump talked about new plans for artificial intelligence.
He wants the US to create an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI leader.
Trump said his government will not stop AI from growing.
Many people have given warnings about the possible dangers of AI.
Trump thinks AI is very important and will be bigger than the Internet.
He also said his government would stop bad actors who use AI for wrong things.
Some experts say AI development should slow down.

vocabulary.definition: ideas about what someone will do in the future
a group of people working together for a special purpose
a person who guides or controls a group
the group of people who control a country
information that tells you about a possible danger or problem
to make something move or happen more slowly
